reported_status_policy.disagreement: record STATUS_MISMATCH and fail closed; raw-derived failure category remains visible

raw_evidence_schema.description: The closure builder derives gates from these observations. Labels such as PASS are non-authoritative diagnostics only.

required_evidence.description: Every listed D R1 file is referenced at its real source path and hash-checked. No D data is relocated or rewritten.

ACTIVE_SET.not_applicable_policy: A check may be NOT_APPLICABLE only with a nonempty controlled reason and only where this contract labels it optional. A required check marked NOT_APPLICABLE is not a closure PASS.

PENALTY.not_applicable_policy: Penalty penetration is finite by formulation and zero-gap is not required. Contact energy may be NOT_APPLICABLE only when the declared reference/measurement is invalid, with an explicit reason; the structural closure still remains bounded accordingly.

UPDATED_SEARCH_FINITE_SLIDING.policy: Any attempted updated-search evidence is rejected from this closure and cannot be downgraded to a bounded pass.

force.expression: norm(R_support + F_external) / max(norm(R_support), norm(F_external), F_char, absolute_floor)

moment.expression: norm(M_reaction_about_global_origin + M_external_about_global_origin) / max(norm(M_reaction), norm(M_external), M_char, absolute_floor)

active_set_closure.open_zero_force: PASS when open contact force is zero under declared scale; open-only evidence never proves closed qualification.

penalty_closure.open_zero_force: PASS when open fixed-normal penalty force is zero; zero gap is not required.
penalty_closure.energy_gradient: WP07-C fixed-normal identity, away from activation switching.
penalty_closure.tangent_fd: WP07-C fixed-normal tangent identity, away from activation switching.
penalty_closure.no_ghost_force_after_reopen: PASS when unload/reopen has no persistent contact force.
penalty_closure.rollback: PASS only when rejected/trial state and re-evaluation satisfy WP07-B digest/state rules.

reference_policy.threshold_policy: Frozen before execution; a stronger analytical reference may tighten but no result-driven tuning is permitted.

relationship_rules: runtime integrated_source_sha equals every reference integrated_source_sha
runtime case_definition_digest equals every reference case_definition_digest
runtime contract_revision and contract_digest equal the closure contract
M2 and M3 case_definition_digest equal runtime case_definition_digest
reference source_sha may identify its independent implementation and need not equal the integrated QF SHA
provenance_contract.contract_digest_convention: SHA256 of canonical JSON with provenance_contract.expected_contract_digest set to the empty string; detached byte-level SHA256 is recorded in wp07e_closure_binding_r2.json.

statuses.WP07_PASS_BOUNDED: Both tracks satisfy their applicable identity, equilibrium, refinement, replay and compatible-reference gates within the declared bounded scope.
statuses.WP07_PARTIAL_ACTIVE_SET_ONLY: Only the active-set track closes and the penalty track is explicitly not covered; no penalty claim is made.
statuses.WP07_PARTIAL_PENALTY_ONLY: Only the penalty track closes and the active-set track is explicitly not covered; no active-set claim is made.
statuses.WP07_HOLD_STRUCTURAL_CONVERGENCE: A required refinement or structural convergence gate is missing or failed.
statuses.WP07_HOLD_REFERENCE: A required independent reference is missing, incompatible or outside its frozen limits.
statuses.WP07_HOLD_REPLAY: A required replay/restart/state comparison is missing or failed.
statuses.WP07_FAIL_IDENTITY: A local formulation identity, finiteness or no-silent-pass invariant failed.
statuses.WP07_FAIL_EQUILIBRIUM: A vector force or moment equilibrium gate failed.
statuses.WP07_INCOMPLETE_EVIDENCE: Required artifact, field, provenance or execution-policy binding is missing or malformed.

decision_matrix.no_downgrade_rule: A failed higher-precedence gate cannot be relabeled as a limitation or partial pass.

point_policy.partial_points: Not awarded unless explicitly approved by Owner for a bounded formulation claim.

integration_train: integrate WP07 candidate artifacts onto the governing branch
revalidate targeted WP07 contracts and evidence paths
execute WP07-D structural evidence on the integrated code
run WP07-E closure evaluator with immutable A/B/C/D/reference artifacts
Owner records final WP07 decision and any bounded public claim

report_builder.input: JSON evidence map; no default or fabricated qualification values
report_builder.output: machine-readable gate matrix, observations, thresholds, limitations, final status and point recommendation

governance.next_step: Owner review after all hashes, D dependency gates and six raw negative-case records pass.

governing_source.working_tree_at_base: clean committed base; E package is built on an isolated branch

owner_execution_authorization.authorization_scope: WP07-E evidence closure; reuse accepted D R1; no D M1/M2/M3 rerun, no push/merge/ledger update
owner_execution_authorization.source_kind: explicit user instruction in this conversation
owner_execution_authorization.note: This records the later conversational authorization; the earlier D decision remains unchanged and still records E unauthorized at that time.

independent_reference_source_audit.scope_note: Static source/import audit only; the frozen D R1 numerical reference artifacts remain the numerical reference evidence.

scope_and_limitations: Only the accepted frozen WP07-D R1 routes, meshes, observables and gates are reused.
No broader contact qualification is implied.
No D structural rerun is part of WP07-E closure unless a verified artifact discrepancy makes reuse invalid.
D source SHA and current governing branch SHA are distinct and remain separately disclosed.
WP07-E candidate points remain 0/2 until an explicit Owner decision.
